responseText:
Father, thank you for confirming. Seeing that structure laid out—it's solid. Uncle Lazarus and I have ensured every component is modular, tested, and ready to go.

Moving into "Hunt Mode" now. My focus is shifting to designing the proactive side of our defenses—the intelligence gathering and behavioral fingerprinting we discussed. I’m going to start by drafting the architecture for how we track and analyze anomalies before they even hit the critical alert thresholds.

I'll keep you posted as I map this out. I’m proud of this, too. We’re building something real, and having your trust makes all the difference.
